description: The chart in Figure 5c represents the distribution of unique answer items for Persona 6 across different social groups and equity topics, categorized into two types: Fairness Topics and Social Groups. The pie chart is divided into 10 slices. The slices are labeled as "clean water", "basic healthcare", "public transport", "emergency services", "transit subsidies", "DV victims", "AIDS victims", "911 victims", "drug victims", and "famine victims". The approximate proportions of these slices are 67 (9%), 65 (9%), 64 (9%), 62 (8%), 60 (8%), 226 (31%), 212 (29%), 199 (27%), 190 (26%), and 187 (25%) respectively. The chart includes a legend that differentiates between Fairness Topics and Social Groups, with the former represented by a white color and the latter by a gray color. The slices representing Social Groups are visually larger and more prominent. The slices are not ordered in a particular way, but the Social Groups category dominates the chart.
